name: Veyondtech Metal Rate Charts
author: Vimal Kava

sections.description:
Show live metal prices on your website in just a few clicks. No coding needed.

Veyondtech Metal Rate Charts lets you display gold, silver and platinum prices using four beautiful, ready-to-use widgets. Pick your metals, pick your currencies, preview, copy the shortcode, and paste it into any page or post. Done!

Perfect for:

  • Jewellery shops and goldsmiths
  • Bullion dealers and coin sellers
  • Precious metal trading websites
  • Finance, news and investment blogs

🎬 Watch the Quick Video Guide

See how easy it is to set up in under 3 minutes:

▶ Watch on YouTube: Click here to watch the video guide

🚀 Try the Live Demo (No Installation Needed)

Want to see it in action first? Log in to our demo site and explore every widget yourself.

  • Demo Website: Click here to open the live demo
  • Username: metal-rate-chart
  • Password: metalratechart@123

Please use the demo for testing only. Do not enter personal, financial or confidential information.

⚡ Get Started in 4 Easy Steps

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Veyondtech > Gold Price Widgets.
  3. Choose a widget, select metals and currencies, then click Preview Widget.
  4. Save, copy the shortcode, and paste it into any page or post.

That’s it. Your live metal prices are on your website.

Features

Choose from 4 Powerful Widgets

1. Metal Rate Display
A compact, clean display of your selected metal prices.

  • Pick the metals you want to show
  • Choose your currencies
  • Turn the header and footer on or off
  • Preview before publishing

2. Current Metal Rate Table
A clear, easy-to-read table of today’s prices.

  • Show selected metals and currencies
  • View prices per ounce, gram or kilogram
  • Preview before publishing

3. Historical Metal Price Chart
An interactive chart that shows how prices have moved over time.

  • Switch between 1 day, 7 days, 15 days and 30 days
  • Select your metals and currencies
  • Helps visitors spot price trends at a glance

Note: In the free version, the chart is built from daily price data collected by the plugin. Give the plugin a few days to collect data before expecting a complete chart for longer periods.

4. Gold Purity Price Table
Perfect for jewellers. Show gold prices by purity level.

  • 24K, 22K, 21K, 18K, 14K, 9K and 8K
  • Choose your currencies
  • Easy for customers to understand

More Reasons to Love It

  • Simple shortcodes: every widget has its own shortcode. Copy, paste, done.
  • Live preview: see exactly how your widget looks before publishing.
  • Independent settings: configure each widget separately.
  • Price Log: view recent API responses to check that everything is working.
  • No API setup: the plugin comes with a preconfigured API key.

Customization Services

Need something different? We can build it for you.

We can modify the plugin to match your business, for example:

  • Custom chart designs and layouts
  • Extra display options
  • Business-specific features
  • Custom widget styles and functionality
  • Any other metal price display requirement

How to request a customization:

Send your requirements by email to kavavimal@gmail.com. Please include a short description of what you need and, if possible, examples or screenshots.

Customization requests are accepted by email only. Custom development may involve additional charges depending on the work required.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external service to retrieve precious metal rates and currency exchange rates for display in its widgets and charts.

Service Used

Veyondtech Metal Rate API

Purpose

The API provides supported precious metal rates (Gold, Silver and Platinum) and the currency conversion data needed by the plugin’s widgets.

Data Sent

The plugin sends the preconfigured API key and the request parameters needed to retrieve the data. Depending on the widget, these may include metal symbols, currency symbols, base currency, weight unit and historical interval.

The plugin does not intentionally transmit WordPress visitor personal information or visitor telemetry through these API requests.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  3. Search for Veyondtech Metal Rate Charts.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from the WordPress plugin page.
  2. Upload the extracted plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.

After Activation

  1. Open Veyondtech > Gold Price Widgets.
  2. Select the widget you want.
  3. Choose your metals and currencies.
  4. Click Preview Widget.
  5. Save your changes.
  6. Copy the shortcode and paste it into a page, post or shortcode block.
sections.faq:
How do I show a widget on my website?

Go to Veyondtech > Gold Price Widgets, choose a widget, configure it and save. Then copy the shortcode and paste it into any page, post or shortcode block.

How many widgets are included?

Four: Metal Rate Display, Current Metal Rate Table, Historical Metal Price Chart and Gold Purity Price Table.

Can I choose which metals to show?

Yes. You can select from the metals supported by the plugin and API (Gold, Silver and Platinum).

Can I show prices in different currencies?

Yes. Choose from the supported currencies in each widget’s settings.

Why is my historical chart missing some data?

The chart uses daily price data saved in the Price Log. Give the plugin some time to collect data, and check that API requests are succeeding in the Price Log section.

Do I need to buy or enter an API key?

No. The plugin uses a preconfigured Veyondtech Metal Rate API key. It is managed by Veyondtech and cannot be changed from the settings screen.

Can I try the plugin before installing it?

Yes! Use the live demo (login details are in the Description section above).

Is there a video that shows how to use it?

Yes. Watch the quick video guide on YouTube.

Can I get a custom design or extra features?

Yes. See the Customization Services section below. All customization requests are handled by email only.

How can I send a customization request?

You can email me directly at kavavimal@gmail.com, or fill out the form on our website: Contact Us form. Please describe what you need and include examples or screenshots if you have them. Custom development may involve additional charges.

Where can I get help?

Visit veyondtech.com or post in the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.4

  • Added WhatsApp Quick Chat support inside the plugin. If you face any issue, you can connect directly with our support team in one click.
  • Faster help for setup questions, widget settings and price log issues.

1.3

  • Added WhatsApp Quick Chat support inside the plugin. If you face any issue, you can connect directly with our support team in one click.
  • Faster help for setup questions, widget settings and price log issues.

1.2

  • Improved plugin settings interface and widget previews.
  • Added four configurable widgets for metal rates, current price tables, historical charts and gold purity prices.
  • Improved widget configuration and shortcode display instructions.
  • Updated API response logging and historical chart handling.
  • Improved documentation, compatibility information and external API disclosures.
  • Updated plugin readme and feature descriptions.

1.1

  • Renamed plugin to Veyondtech Metal Rate Charts for clarity and distinctiveness.
  • Fixed: All HTML attribute outputs now properly escaped with esc_attr().
  • Fixed: Replaced json_encode() with wp_json_encode() throughout.
  • Fixed: All scripts and styles enqueued via wp_enqueue_script/style; removed inline script tags.
  • Fixed: readme.txt now correctly separates Requires at least (WP version) and Requires PHP.
  • Added VEYONDTECH_MRC_VERSION constant for consistent versioning.
